notes.title: [RMAsia] Demo Version of "The Hearts of Immortality," a Tribute to Classic RPGs, Has Been Released
notes.notes:
[code]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/RMA]Follow RMAsia Connoisseurs[/url]
[/code]

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/41570851/5b3b6386668809b4a9f26ac8e8773717ad8e14d6.jpg[/img]
After two years of dedicated work, as a tribute to classic long-form fantasy RPGs, The Hearts of Immortality is finally ready for Early Access!

This game blends both narrative and combat elements, and you'll find plenty of the creator's hardcore nerd style throughout, including a wide variety of selectable classes and the player-driven dialogue choices.
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/41570851/ccc79d063fc700d41ac5de90cf2513e376d6ee78.png[/img]

You can check out the DEMO version here, which includes the prologue and Act 1, "The Butcher of Laughmouth":
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3433660/Demo/
Download and try it out if you're interested – give it a go!

If you enjoy the demo, please add it to your wishlist – pretty please, pretty please~ ːsteamthumbsupː
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3431480/
